Name: Tempest Strikes
Description:
You can channel the power of the tempests, which remains with you for the spell’s duration. As a bonus action, you can make a single melee spell attack against a target within 10 feet, or a ranged spell attack against a target within 60 feet, dealing 2d6 tempest damage on a hit.

Tempestuous Knowledge. When you learn this spell or choose to prepare it, choose one type of tempest damage. This spell always deals that type of damage when it references tempest damage. You can choose to learn or prepare this spell multiple times, choosing a different tempest damage type each time, and you can use those options instead when it refers to tempest damage.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 2nd level or higher, you may choose one of the following effects for each level above 1st:
• The spell deals an additional 1d6 of tempest damage.
• The ranged spell attack range doubles.
• The spell’s duration increases until your next Short Rest (1 level) or your next Long Rest (3 levels).
• (2 levels) You do not need to concentrate on this spell.
• (2 levels) You make an additional attack against a target within range.
